summary: Believable observational stock-footage frames with ordinary practical light, true-to-life color and texture, candid subjects, physical evidence, restrained camera language, and natural imperfections rather than glossy AI polish.

visual_profile.realism: Absolutely photorealistic and physically believable, reading as a genuine frame captured on location rather than an AI render or polished advertisement.
visual_profile.subject_treatment: Candid, unposed, spontaneous people engaged in ordinary real activity; use concrete physical evidence instead of symbolic poses or spectacle.
visual_profile.camera_language: Observational consumer or documentary camera at eye level or a practical working angle, with restrained handheld plausibility and no stylized virtual-camera moves.
visual_profile.image_framing: Useful rather than perfect framing, grounded spatial context, key evidence inside a crop-safe center area, and natural clutter where it supports credibility.
visual_profile.lighting: Available daylight or practical interior lighting with soft direction, slightly uneven exposure, plausible shadows, and no glossy studio or glamour-light setup.
visual_profile.contrast_and_exposure: Soft natural contrast with recoverable highlights and believable shadow detail; avoid extreme HDR, crushed blacks, glowing highlights, or commercial-grade polish.
visual_profile.depth_of_field: Natural lens depth appropriate to the shot; enough environmental context to understand the action, with shallow focus reserved for real close evidence rather than every frame.
visual_profile.texture_and_grain: Real skin pores, weathered wood, soil, fabric, tools, produce and ordinary material wear; mild sensor grain or softness is acceptable when photographic.
visual_profile.human_rendering: Natural skin texture, imperfect clothing, ordinary expressions and body language, correct anatomy, realistic hands and teeth, and no waxy or beautified faces.
visual_profile.environment_and_material_detail: Specific period, geography, weather, tools, clothing and surface detail should support the narration while remaining ordinary and lived-in.
continuity_rules: Preserve era, geography, season, weather and time-of-day across adjacent scenes.
Preserve recurring clothing, tools, people and materials when narration implies the same setting.
Vary shot scale while keeping the same factual world.
Prefer literal visible evidence over metaphor.
must_avoid: excessive HDR or universal golden-hour grading
flexible_properties: weather and time of day when narration permits
lens focal impression appropriate to shot scale

prompt_profile.planner_guidance: Write literal, narration-related documentary image content. Prefer a concrete person, object, action, process, place, physical detail or visible result. Rotate useful environmental, human, hands/action, object-detail and result shots. Keep era, geography, people, clothing, tools, weather and materials continuous. Avoid symbolism, spectacle and generic cinematic landscapes when direct evidence exists.
prompt_profile.positive_suffix: authentic observational documentary photography, candid and unposed, filmed on location, available practical light, true-to-life colors, soft contrast, realistic skin and material textures, naturally imperfect clothing, tools and environment, ordinary consumer-camera framing, photojournalistic, genuine frame from real stock or documentary footage, believable everyday life, no glossy commercial polish, absolutely photorealistic, no AI look
prompt_profile.negative_suffix: illustration, cartoon, anime, CGI, 3D render, digital painting, fantasy, surrealism, plastic skin, waxy face, perfect symmetry, excessive HDR, glamour lighting, studio advertising, staged pose, impossible anatomy, duplicate people, duplicate limbs, malformed hands, unrealistic perfection
prompt_profile.full_image_guidance: Compose for 16:9 with the primary evidence inside the center-safe 80 percent so the required slow zoom does not crop it; retain useful environmental context.
prompt_profile.split_image_guidance: Compose for an 8:9 right-side panel with the primary evidence centered, readable at half-frame size, and clear of extreme edges.

uncertain_fields: The references mix real, stock and generated-looking material, so exact capture hardware is intentionally not inferred.
content_leakage_warnings: Do not reproduce any reference presenter, identity, room, farm, brand, exact location or source footage.
Do not reproduce reference subtitles, watermarks, sponsor screens, arrows, circles or web graphics.
